name: Webflow
tagline: Webflow is a visual web development platform that lets designers build production-ready, custom-coded websites through a visual editor — without writing HTML, CSS, or JavaScript directly. Its AI Diffing feature and component-based design system support enterprise-scale design ops workflows. Agencies and marketing teams choose Webflow for the creative freedom of a custom build with the speed of a no-code tool.
